chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"Whoever is shown kindness, let him reciprocate it. If he is unable, then let him offer praise. If he does not do so, then he has been ungrateful for the blessing."

key_terms.النِّعْمَةَ: the blessing or favor that has been bestowed
key_terms.الْمَعْرُوفُ: kindness or a good deed shown to someone
key_terms.فَلْيُثْنِ: let him praise and verbally acknowledge the favor
key_terms.فَلْيُكَافِئْ: let him reciprocate or repay the good done to him

ai.seo_question: What should a Muslim do when someone shows him kindness?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a person should respond to kindness by repaying it in kind. If that is not possible, one should at least express praise and gratitude; failing to do even that is ingratitude toward the blessing received.
